answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 162132 Country: SAUDI ARABIA Title: In case I missed Isha salah jamat can I join taravih salah jamat and make intention of Isha fardh continue 4 rakah or have to pray separately. Question: In case I missed Isha salah jamat can I join taravih salah jamat and make intention of Isha fardh continue 4 rakah or have to pray separately. Answer ID: 162132 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1291/1087/L=9/1439) It is not valid to make intention of Isha salah in taravih. If your Isha salah is missed then offer fardh salah and then join taravih salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
